subject.title: fix(agents): avoid synthetic overflow in tool-heavy sessions

question: Should OpenClaw make actual provider context rejection, rather than any generic local character-pressure gate, the authority for whole-session overflow recovery across the embedded agent runner?
rationale: The submitted evidence supports the reported false positive, but the choice intentionally changes recovery behavior for all providers and existing session-compaction paths rather than only the aggregate-replacement case.

options.title: Accept provider-authoritative recovery
options.body: Merge this broader fix after current-base validation, keeping local pressure signals limited to prompt shaping and diagnostics.

options.title: Land the narrower aggregate fix
options.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107821 if maintainers want to preserve existing preflight and tool-loop recovery authority pending separate evidence.

recommendation.title: Accept provider-authoritative recovery
recommendation.body: Merge this broader fix after current-base validation, keeping local pressure signals limited to prompt shaping and diagnostics.
